description: This file defines the WindowEvaluatorFactory class and its inner class WindowPartitionEvaluator, which are responsible for creating and evaluating window functions within Spark SQL's execution engine. It manages partitioning, window frame evaluation, and row buffering for window operations.

classes.name: WindowEvaluatorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating window evaluators in Spark SQL, managing window expressions, partitioning, and evaluation.

classes.name: WindowPartitionEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating window functions over partitions, managing buffering, partitioning, and frame evaluation.

methods.name: createEvaluator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of WindowPartitionEvaluator for evaluating window functions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates window functions over a given partition of rows, handling partitioning, buffering, and frame calculations.

methods.name: fetchNextRow
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the input stream and updates the current group key.

methods.name: fetchNextPartition
methods.description: Prepares the buffer with all rows in the current partition and sets up window frames for evaluation.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there are more rows to process in the current partition or input stream.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next row with window function results applied, advancing the buffer and partition as needed.
